ACCEPTANCE_REJECTION_LOGIC.decision_rule: Total return alone can never accept the candidate. Failure of any required structural condition rejects it as the primary V2 candidate. No threshold change, second loss-budget variant, or result-conditioned repair is authorized. If this single variant fails and no separately frozen hypothesis has a unique minimal intervention, conclude NO_DEFENSIBLE_V2_CANDIDATE.

attempts.EXACT_CHANGE: For an existing position not already covered by a market or individual exit, mark the complete cycle at each causally available, hard-valid completed close using prior realized P&L, remaining dividends, split-adjusted shares, remaining cost basis, and total cycle buy cost. If the mark is at or below -10%, add the symbol to the existing forced-exit set for execution at the next eligible open under unchanged T+1, trading-state, limit, fee, and corporate-action semantics. Never execute at the signal close and never substitute a stale or synthetic close.
attempts.EXPECTED_COST: A gap before the next eligible open can exceed the budget, and a later recovery or large winner that first crosses -10% can be truncated. The candidate may also create a new entry cycle after a completed exit under unchanged V1 admission rules.
attempts.EXPECTED_DIRECTION: Reduce the number and realized P&L drag of severe-loss cycles, improve median trade and return excluding the best 20, and preserve at least half of the large-winner identities and >=+20% cycles without increasing concentration or drawdown.
attempts.WHY_THIS_PARAMETER_VALUE: -10% is the single mechanism boundary justified before evaluation by the frozen V1 decomposition: 22 completed cycles at or below -10% contributed -413236.91, while the V1 top-20 winners had only -6.1294% p10 MAE. No tighter threshold or sweep is authorized.
